meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，当你询问代码库相关问题时，Claude 会读取项目里的知识图谱文件，搜索相关节点和连接，然后基于子图信息回答。
howto.when: 当你提出关于代码库的问题或要求理解代码时触发。

say.text: 这个项目的函数调用关系是怎样的？
say.note: Claude 会搜索知识图谱中与函数相关的节点和边。

say.text: 解释一下 main 模块的功能。
say.note: Claude 会查找对应的模块节点及其描述。

say.text: 找出所有依赖外部服务的端点。
say.note: Claude 会搜索端点节点并追踪依赖边。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, when you ask questions about a codebase, Claude reads the knowledge graph file in the project root, searches for relevant nodes and edges, and answers based on the subgraph.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions about a codebase or request code understanding using the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: What is the function call relationship in this project?
say_en.note: Claude searches for function nodes and edges.

say_en.text: Explain the functionality of the main module.
say_en.note: Claude finds the corresponding module node and its summary.

say_en.text: List all endpoints that depend on external services.
say_en.note: Claude searches for endpoint nodes and traces dependency edges.
